rules: Wait for native to seal the existing run and provide the one archive; do not create another archive.
Use file_info and pin expected_version for every bounded binary_read chunk; verify every chunk and full archive SHA256.
Extract only unique relative regular-file entries into this separate directory; reject traversal, links, special files, and conflicting existing bytes.
Verify original index/member lengths and SHA256; verify source SHA256 and Git blob IDs with Git modes from the native source manifest, never tar or extracted filesystem permissions.
Bind commands, tree, environment, lock identity, natural exit, resources and complete raw logs to each original receipt.
Count unique primary test results and source diagnostics without re-counting footer aggregates; preserve failures and original skips.
Cross-check r13 closed strict originals previously saved in r13-strict-closed.
If gzip logs exist, verify original compressed bytes and the decompressed raw log SHA without replacing originals.
Do not read active test logs, edit source or root documents, rerun Rust, change filters, or copy into formal repository evidence without root ownership.
